Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Turret and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can attack.

features.name: Mark Target
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to _Mark_ a target within Far range until the Turret is destroyed or the _Marked_ target becomes _Hidden_. While the target is _Marked_, their Evasion is halved.

features.name: Concentrate Fire
features.text: When another adversary deals damage to a target within Far range of the Turret, you can **mark a Stress** to add the Turret's standard attack damage to the damage roll.

features.name: Detonation
features.text: When the Turret is destroyed, they explode. All targets within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **3d20** physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

name: Young Ice Dragon
description: A glacier-blue dragon with four powerful limbs and frost-tinged wings.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Rend and Crush
features.text: If a target damaged by the Dragon doesn't mark an Armor Slot to reduce the damage, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: No Hope
features.text: When a PC rolls with Fear while within Far range of the Dragon, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Blizzard Breath
features.text: **Spend 2 Fear** to release an icy whorl in front of the Dragon within Close range. All targets in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **4d6+5** magic damage and are _Restrained_ by ice until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Targets who succeed must mark 2 Stress or take half damage.

features.name: Avalanche
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Dragon unleash a huge downfall of snow and ice, covering all other creatures within Far range. All targets within this area must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be buried in snow and rocks, becoming _Vulnerable_ until they dig themselves out from the debris. For each PC that fails the reaction roll, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Frozen Scales
features.text: When a creature makes a successful attack against the Dragon from within Very Close range, they must mark a Stress and become _Chilled_ until their next rest or they clear a Stress. While they are _Chilled_, they have disadvantage on attack rolls.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Dragon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Arch-Necromancer
description: A decaying mage adorned in dark, tattered robes.

features.name: Dance of Death
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to spotlight **1d4** allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage, or full damage if you **spend a Fear**.

features.name: Beam of Decay
features.text: **Mark 2 Stress** to cause all targets within Far range to make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **2d20+12** magic damage and you gain a Fear. Targets who succeed take half damage. A target who marks 2 or more HP must also mark **2 Stress** and becomes _Vulnerable_ until they roll with Hope.

features.name: Open the Gates of Death
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to summon a Zombie Legion, which appears at Close range and immediately takes the spotlight.

features.name: Not Today, My Dears
features.text: When the Necromancer has marked 7 or more of their HP, you can **spend a Fear** to have them teleport away to a safe location to recover. A PC who succeeds on an Instinct Roll can trace the teleportation magic to their destination.

features.name: Your Life Is Mine - Reaction: Countdown (Loop 2d6)
features.text: When the Necromancer has marked 6 or more of their HP, activate the countdown. When it triggers, deal **2d10+6** direct magic damage to a target within Close range. The Necromancer then **clears a number of Stress or HP** equal to the number of HP marked by the target from this attack.

name: Fallen Shock Troop
description: A cursed soul bound to the Fallen's will.

features.name: Minion
features.text: The Shock Troop is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Shock Troop, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Aura of Doom
features.text: When a PC marks HP from an attack by the Shock Troop, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Fallen Shock Troops within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 12 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Fallen Sorcerer
description: A powerful mage bound by the bargains they made in life.

features.name: Conflagration
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to unleash an all-consuming firestorm and make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Sorcerer succeeds against take **2d10+6** direct magic damage.

features.name: Nightmare Tableau
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to trap a target within Far range in a powerful illusion of their worst fears. While trapped, the target is _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ until they break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Instinct Roll.

features.name: Slippery
features.text: When the Sorcerer takes damage from an attack, they can teleport up to Far range.

features.name: Shackles of Guilt - Reaction: Countdown (Loop 2d6)
features.text: When the Sorcerer is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, all targets within Far range become _Vulnerable_ and must mark a Stress as they relive their greatest regrets. A target can break free from their regret with a successful Presence or Strength Roll. When a PC fails to break free, they lose a Hope.

name: Fallen Warlord: Realm-Breaker
description: A Fallen God, wreathed in rage and resentment, bearing millennia of experience in breaking heroes' spirits.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Realm-Breaker can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Firespite Plate Armor
features.text: When the Realm-Breaker takes damage, reduce it by **2d10**.

features.name: Tormenting Lash
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. When a target uses armor to reduce damage from this attack, they must mark 2 Armor Slots.

features.name: All-Consuming Rage - Reaction: Countdown (Decreasing 8)
features.text: When the Realm-Breaker is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, create a torrent of incarnate rage that rends flesh from bone. All targets within Far range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **2d6+10** direct magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage. For each HP marked from this damage, summon a Fallen Shock Troop within Very Close range of the target who marked that HP. If the countdown ever decreases its maximum value to 0, the Realm-Breaker marks their remaining HP and all targets within Far range must mark all remaining HP and make a death move.

features.name: Doombringer
features.text: When a target marks HP from an attack by the Realm-Breaker, all PCs within Far range of the target must lose a Hope.

features.name: I Have Never Known Defeat
features.text: When the Realm-Breaker marks their last HP, replace them with the Undefeated Champion and immediately spotlight them.

name: Fallen Warlord: Undefeated Champion
description: That which only the most feared have a chance to fear.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Undefeated Champion can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Faltering Armor
features.text: When the Undefeated Champion takes damage, reduce it by **1d10**.

features.name: Shattering Strike
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. PCs the Champion succeeds against lose a number of Hope equal to the HP they marked from this attack.

features.name: Endless Legions
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to summon a number of Fallen Shock Troops equal to twice the number of PCs. The Shock Troops appear at Far range.

features.name: Circle of Defilement - Reaction: Countdown (1d8)
features.text: When the Undefeated Champion is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, activate a magical circle covering an area within Far range of the Champion. A target within that area is _Vulnerable_ until they leave the circle. The circle can be removed by dealing Severe damage to the Undefeated Champion.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Undefeated Champion makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Doombringer
features.text: When a target marks HP from an attack by the Undefeated Champion, all PCs within Far range of the target lose a Hope.

name: Hallowed Archer
description: Spirit soldiers with sanctified bows.

features.name: Punish the Guilty
features.text: The Archer deals double damage to targets marked _Guilty_ by a High Seraph.

features.name: Divine Volley
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against up to three targets.

name: Hallowed Soldier
description: Souls of the faithful, lifted up with divine weaponry.

features.name: Minion
features.text: The Soldier is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Soldier, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Divine Flight
features.text: While the Soldier is flying, **spend a Fear** to move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Hallowed Soldiers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 10 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: High Seraph
description: A divine champion, head of a hallowed host of warriors who enforce their god's will.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Seraph can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Divine Flight
features.text: While the Seraph is flying, **spend a Fear** to move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Judgment
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to make a target _Guilty_ in the eyes of the Seraph's god until the Seraph is defeated. While _Guilty_, the target doesn't gain Hope on a result with Hope. When the Seraph succeeds on a standard attack against a _Guilty_ target, they deal Severe damage instead of their standard damage. The Seraph can only mark one target at a time.

features.name: God Rays
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to reflect a sliver of divinity as a searing beam of light that hits up to twenty targets within Very Far range. Targets must make a Presence Reaction Roll, with disadvantage if they are marked _Guilty_. Targets who fail take **4d6+12** magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: We Are One
features.text: Once per scene, **spend a Fear** to spotlight all other adversaries within Far range. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

name: Kraken
description: A legendary beast of the sea, bigger than the largest galleon, with sucker-laden tentacles and a terrifying maw.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Kraken can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Many Tentacles
features.text: While the Kraken has 7 or fewer marked HP, they can make their standard attack against two targets within range.

features.name: Grapple and Drown
features.text: Make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, **mark a Stress** to grab them with a tentacle and drag them beneath the water. The target is _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ until they break free with a successful Strength Roll or the Kraken takes Major or greater damage. While _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ in this way, a target must mark a Stress when they make an action roll.

features.name: Boiling Blast
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to spew a line of boiling water at any number of targets in a line up to Far range. All targets must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **4d6+9** physical damage. If a target marks an Armor Slot to reduce the damage, they must also mark a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Kraken makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Oracle of Doom
description: A towering immortal and incarnation of fate, cursed to only see bad outcomes.

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Oracle makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Walls Closing In
features.text: When a creature rolls a failure while within Very Far range of the Oracle, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Pronounce Fate
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to present a target within Far range with a vision of their personal nightmare. The target must make a Knowledge Reaction Roll. On a failure, they lose all Hope and take **2d20+4** direct magic damage. On a success, they take half damage and lose a Hope.

features.name: Summon Tormentors
features.text: Once per day, **spend 2 Fear** to summon **2d4** Tier 2 or below Minions relevant to one of the PC's personal nightmares. They appear at Close range relative to that PC.

features.name: Ominous Knowledge
features.text: When the Oracle sees a mortal creature, they instantly know one of their personal nightmares.

features.name: Vengeful Fate
features.text: When the Oracle marks HP from an attack within Very Close range, you can **mark a Stress** to knock the attacker back to Far range and deal **2d10+4** physical damage.

name: Outer Realms Abomination
description: A chaotic mockery of life, constantly in flux.

features.name: Chaotic Form
features.text: When the Abomination attacks, roll **2d4** and use the result as their attack modifier.

features.name: Disorienting Presence
features.text: When a target takes damage from the Abomination, they must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, they gain disadvantage on their next action roll and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Reality Quake
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to rattle the edges of reality within Far range of the Abomination. All targets within that area must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or become _Unstuck_ from reality until the end of the scene. When an _Unstuck_ target spends Hope or marks Armor Slots, HP, or Stress, they must double the amount spent or marked.

features.name: Unreal Form
features.text: When the Abomination takes damage, reduce it by **1d20**. If the Abomination marks 1 or fewer Hit Points from a successful attack against them, you gain a Fear.

name: Outer Realms Corruptor
description: A shifting, formless mass seemingly made of chromatic light.

features.name: Will-Shattering Touch
features.text: When a PC takes damage from the Corruptor, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Disgorge Reality Flotsam
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to spew partially digested portions of consumed realities at all targets within Close range. Targets must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or mark 2 Stress.

name: Outer Realms Thrall
description: A vaguely humanoid form stripped of memory and identity.

features.name: Minion
features.text: The Thrall is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Thrall, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Outer Realm Thralls within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 11 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Volcanic Dragon: Obsidian Predator
description: A massive winged creature with obsidian scales and impossibly sharp claws.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Obsidian Predator can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Flying
features.text: While flying, the Obsidian Predator gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Obsidian Scales
features.text: The Obsidian Predator is resistant to physical damage.

features.name: Avalanche Tail
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Obsidian Predator succeeds against take **4d6+4** physical damage and are knocked back to Far range and _Vulnerable_ until their next roll with Hope.

features.name: Dive-Bomb
features.text: If the Obsidian Predator is flying, **mark a Stress** to choose a point within Far range. Move to that point and make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Obsidian Predator succeeds against take **2d10+6** physical damage and must mark a Stress and lose a Hope.

features.name: Erupting Rage
features.text: When the Obsidian Predator marks their last HP, replace them with the Molten Scourge and immediately spotlight them.

name: Volcanic Dragon: Molten Scourge
description: Enraged by their wounds, the dragon bursts into molten lava.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Molten Scourge can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Cracked Scales
features.text: When the Molten Scourge takes damage, roll a number of **d6s** equal to HP marked. For each result of 4 or higher, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Shattering Might
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, the target takes **4d8+1** physical damage, loses a Hope, and is knocked back to Close range. The Molten Scourge clears a Stress.

features.name: Eruption
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to erupt lava from beneath the Molten Scourge's scales, filling the area within Very Close range with molten lava. All targets in that area must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **4d6+6** physical damage and be knocked back to Close range. This area remains lava. When a creature other than the Molten Scourge enters that area or acts while inside of it, they must mark 6 HP.

features.name: Volcanic Breath
features.text: When the Molten Scourge takes Major damage, roll a **d10**. On a result of 8 or higher, the Molten Scourge breathes a flow of lava in front of them within Far range. All targets in that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **2d10+4** physical damage, mark **1d4 Stress**, and are _Vulnerable_ until they clear a Stress. Targets who succeed take half damage and must mark a Stress.

features.name: Lava Splash
features.text: When the Molten Scourge takes Severe damage from an attack within Very Close range, molten blood gushes from the wound and deals **2d10+4** direct physical damage to the attacker.

features.name: Ashen Vengeance
features.text: When the Molten Scourge marks their last HP, replace them with the Ashen Tyrant and immediately spotlight them.

name: Volcanic Dragon: Ashen Tyrant
description: No enemy has ever had the insolence to wound the dragon so. As the lava settles, it's ground to ash like the dragon's past foes.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Ashen Tyrant can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Cornered
features.text: **Mark a Stress** instead of spending a Fear to spotlight the Ashen Tyrant.

features.name: Injured Wings
features.text: While flying, the Ashen Tyrant gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Ashes to Ashes
features.text: When a PC rolls a failure while within Close range of the Ashen Tyrant, they lose a Hope and you gain a Fear. If the PC can't lose a Hope, they must mark a HP.

features.name: Desperate Rampage
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Ashen Tyrant succeeds against take **2d20+2** physical damage, are knocked back to Close range of where they were, and must mark a Stress.

features.name: Ashen Cloud
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to smash the ground and kick up ash within Far range. While within the ash cloud, a target has disadvantage on action rolls. The ash cloud clears the next time an adversary is spotlighted.

features.name: Apocalyptic Thrashing - Action: Countdown (1d12)
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to activate. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, the Ashen Tyrant thrashes about, causing environmental damage (such as an earthquake, avalanche, or collapsing walls). All targets within Far range must make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **2d10+10** physical damage and are _Restrained_ by the rubble until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Targets who succeed take half damage. If the Ashen Tyrant is defeated while this countdown is active, trigger the countdown immediately as the destruction caused by their death throes.

name: Perfected Zombie
description: A towering, muscular zombie with magically infused strength and skill.

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Zombie makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Fearsome Presence
features.text: PCs can't spend Hope to use features against the Zombie.

features.name: Perfect Strike
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Zombie succeeds against are _Vulnerable_ until their next rest.

features.name: Skilled Opportunist
features.text: When another adversary deals damage to a target within Very Close range of the Zombie, you can **spend a Fear** to add the Zombie's standard attack damage to the damage roll.

name: Zombie Legion
description: A large pack of undead, still powerful despite their rotting flesh.

features.name: Horde
features.text: When the Legion has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **2d6+5** physical damage instead.

features.name: Unyielding
features.text: The Legion has resistance to physical damage.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Legion can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.text: When the Legion takes Minor damage from an attack within Melee range, you can **mark a Stress** to make a standard attack with advantage against the attacker.

name: Ahuizotl
description: A doglike ambush predator that has a clawed hand on the end of a long prehensile tail and drags victims into rivers to drown them.

features.name: Aquatic Attacker
features.text: When the Ahuizotl attacks from the water, it has advantage on the attack and deals an extra **1d6** damage.

features.name: Tail Swat
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal **1d8+2** physical damage.

features.name: Drag and Bag
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Ahuizotl grab a target within Close range with its tail, pull the target into Melee range, and temporarily _Restrain_ them. The Ahuizotl has advantage on attacks against targets _Restrained_ in this way.

name: Atototl
description: A majestic green water bird that has a ten-foot wingspan and is hunted for the fortune-telling stone inside their stomach.

features.name: Wind Lord
features.text: While the Atototl is flying, attacks against it is made with disadvantage.

features.name: Stone of Omens
features.text: Inside the Atototl is a stone that foretells good or ill fortune, depending on its color. A PC who searches the Atototl's remains finds the stone and makes a fate roll. On an even result, the PC gains Hope equal to half the result, which they can distribute among the PCs however they wish. On an odd result, you gain Fear equal to half the result.

features.name: Archer's Bane
features.text: When a creature beyond Very Close range would deal damage to the Atototl with a weapon attack, you can **spend a Fear** to make an attack roll against them. On a success, whirling winds reflect the attack and deal the attacker's damage back to them.

name: Bugboar
description: A large bipedal creature that has a tusked snout and coarse fur.

features.name: Surprise!
features.text: If the Bugboar makes its first attack in a scene before it's marked HP or Stress, it has advantage on the attack and deals an extra **1d8** damage.

features.name: Brutal
features.text: When the Bugboar makes a successful standard attack, you can **mark a Stress** to deal an extra **1d6** damage.

features.name: Warheart
features.text: When a condition would be imposed on the Bugboar, you can **spend a Fear** to negate it.

name: Common Ruffian
description: A local laborer or artisan pushed by circumstances to assail others.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Ruffians within Close range of them. The Ruffians move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal **1d8** physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Survival Instinct
features.text: When the Ruffian marks half their HP, roll a **d6**. On a result of 4 or higher, the Ruffian flees the scene. Otherwise, you gain a Fear.

name: Darkweave Crawler
description: A spider the size of a human head, woven out of shadow-silk.

features.name: Minion
features.text: The Crawler is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Crawler, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Skin-Crawling
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to force all PCs within Melee range of the Crawler to mark a Stress.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Darkweave Crawlers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Darkweave Venom
features.text: When the Crawler makes a successful attack, you can **mark a Stress** to _Exhaust_ the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll (9). While _Exhausted_, the target must mark a Stress each time they make an action roll.

name: Darkweave Queen
description: A wagon-sized spider woven from shadow-silk by a long-forgotten god. Each of her many eyes bears the face of a different victim.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Queen can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight her.

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When a PC fails an attack roll against the Queen, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Den Mother
features.text: Once per scene, **spend 2 Fear** to summon up to two Darkweave adversaries (other than Darkweave Queens), who appear within Close range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: Quicker Than She Looks
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to move up to Far range and make a standard attack with advantage.

features.name: Darkfang Envenomation
features.text: When the Queen succeeds on a standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to make the target _Vulnerable_ and _Restrained_ until they succeed on a Strength Roll (12) or take a rest.

name: Darkweave Spinner
description: A boar-sized arachnid woven from primordial shadow-silk.

features.name: Wrap in Shadow-Silk
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target is _Vulnerable_ and _Restrained_ until they succeed on a Strength Roll (10).

features.name: Shadow Fang
features.text: When the Spinner makes a successful attack against a target within Melee range, you can **spend a Fear** to make the target _Shaky_ until they succeed on an Instinct Roll (10). While _Shaky_, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls.

name: Darkweave Swarmlings
description: A teeming swarm of tiny spiders woven out of shadow-silk.

features.name: Horde
features.text: When the Swarmlings have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **1d4** physical damage instead.

features.name: "Get 'em Off, Get 'em Off!"
features.text: When an attack from the Swarmlings causes a target to mark HP, you can **mark a Stress** to make the target temporarily _Covered in Spiders._ While _Covered_ _in Spiders,_ the target must roll a **d6** when they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or higher, they must mark a Stress or you gain a Fear.

name: Elk
description: A large deer.

features.name: Headbutt
features.text: When the Elk moves from Close range or farther before making a standard attack, it deals **1d12+2** physical damage instead of its standard damage.

features.name: Bolt
features.text: When the Elk marks a HP or Stress, it must succeed on a Reaction Roll (10) or flee the scene.

name: Falcon
description: A bird of prey that has long, pointed wings and a notched beak.

features.name: Nimble Flyer
features.text: While flying, the Falcon gains a +3 bonus to its Difficulty.

features.name: Dive Bomb
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against a target from above. The Falcon gains a +2 bonus to the attack and damage rolls.

name: Grimmling Warband
description: A cluster of small, strange creatures wearing armor fashioned from trash and stolen housewares.

features.name: Horde
features.text: When the Warband has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals **1d4+1** physical damage instead.

features.name: Cowardly
features.text: When the Warband marks its last Stress or an allied Leader is defeated, roll a **d6**. On a result of 2 or lower, the Warband flees the scene.

name: Harpy
motives: drop enemies from a great height
description: A fierce and foul-smelling bird with an eight-foot wingspan and the upper body and face of a human.

features.name: Toxic Aura
features.text: The Harpy emits a foul stench that renders all non-Harpies _Vulnerable_ while within Very Close range.

features.name: Swooping Attack
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Harpy move in a straight line to a point within Far range and make an attack against a target in the Harpy's path. On a success, the Harpy deals **3d6** physical damage.

name: Kelpie
motives: Adopt an attractive or useful shape
description: A river-dwelling shapeshifter who prefers an enchanting equine form in and out of the water.

features.name: Captivating
features.text: A PC must mark a Stress to move out of the Kelpie's Melee range.

features.name: Heart's Desire
features.text: After the Kelpie interacts with or watches a creature for at least a hundred heartbeats, the Kelpie knows the physical form that creature would find most pleasing or alluring.

features.name: Shapeshifter
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to change the Kelpie's physical form into any creature or object smaller than a wagon. A creature has disadvantage on rolls against the Kelpie while the Kelpie is in a form the creature finds pleasing or alluring.

features.name: Enchant
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Kelpie beguile a PC within Close range. The PC must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or become _Enchanted_ until they take damage. While _Enchanted_, the PC perceives the Kelpie as a trusted friend or ally and will do what the Kelpie says unless it contradicts the PC's most deeply held morals.

name: Masque Muerte
description: The raging soul of a villainous masked wrestler.

features.name: Libre
features.text: The Masque Muerte can't be _Restrained_.

features.name: Heel Turn
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, the target must mark a Stress and is temporarily _Vulnerable_ as the Masque Muerte assaults them with a string of insulting taunts.

features.name: Spectral Suplex
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Masque Muerte suplex a _Restrained_ PC, dealing **1d10+6** magic damage to them.

features.name: Unmasking Death
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Masque Muerte momentarily remove their mask, revealing their horrifying face underneath. Each PC within Close range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or mark a Stress.

features.name: Tag Team
features.text: When the Masque Muerte deals damage to a PC, you can **spend a Fear** to have a spectral wrestler appear and _Pin_ the target until they escape with a successful Strength Roll. While _Pinned_, the target is _Restrained_ and takes an extra **1d12** magic damage from the Masque Muerte's attacks.

name: Mechanorb
description: A floating clockwork sphere that has telescoping limbs and comes from a realm of machines and metal.

features.name: Hive Mind
features.text: The Mechanorb gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty for each other Mechanorb within Close range.

features.name: Adaptive Tactics
features.text: _Pool._ When the Mechanorb fails an attack roll, add a token to the Mechanorb Pool. All Mechanorbs in the scene gain a bonus to attack rolls equal to the number of tokens in the Mechanorb Pool. Clear all tokens when any Mechanorb takes Severe damage or is defeated.

name: Mountain Troll
description: A hideous giant born out of a massive rock. They wear purloined armor and a belt of severed heads or skulls.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Troll can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Stolen Armor
features.text: _Countdown._ When combat begins, activate a countdown with a value equal to the number of PCs. When the Troll takes damage, reduce the severity by one threshold, then tick down the countdown. When it triggers, the Troll evolves (see "Enraged Mountain Troll").

features.name: Flail Swipe
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against all targets in front of the Troll within Very Close range. Targets the Troll succeeds against take **2d8+2** physical damage.

features.name: Enraged Mountain Troll
features.text: The Troll loses their "Stolen Armor" and "Flail Swipe" features, then gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty. Additionally, they gain the "Double Swipe" feature and replace "Skull Flail" with the following standard attack: **Claw Swipe:** Very Close | 1d10+3 phy

features.name: Double Swipe
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to move up to Close range and make two standard attacks against a target within Melee range. If both attacks succeed, combine the damage, and the target loses a Hope.

name: Octopus
description: An aquatic, soft-bodied mollusk that has eight sucker-bearing arms and a hard, beaklike jaw.

features.name: Grapple
features.text: Make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target becomes _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ until they escape with a successful Strength Roll.

features.name: Squirt Ink
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Octopus squirt ink. On land, the ink covers the ground within Very Close range. Each creature who moves through that area must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or slip and fall, becoming _Vulnerable_ until they exit the area. If this feature is used while the Octopus is underwater, it instead creates a cloud of darkness that fills an area within Very Close range and blocks line of sight.

name: Panther
description: A large feline predator that stalks its prey from the shadows.

features.name: Shadow Stalker
features.text: While _Hidden_, the Panther gains a +2 bonus to its attack rolls.

features.name: Pouncing Strike
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Panther leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal **1d12+2** physical damage.

name: Phantom
description: The echo of a lost soul in the form of an ectoplasmic shadow.

features.name: Incorporeal
features.text: The Phantom has resistance to physical damage and can move through solid objects.

features.name: Fear Aura
features.text: A PC who takes the spotlight within Very Close range of the Phantom must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (10) or mark a Stress.

features.name: Lingering Haunt
features.text: _Countdown (1d6)._ When the Phantom is defeated, you can **spend a Fear** to activate the countdown. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, clear the Phantom's HP and immediately spotlight them.

name: Poltergeist
description: A baleful, translucent spirit that possesses inanimate objects.

features.name: Specter
features.text: The Poltergeist has resistance to physical damage. **Mark a Stress** to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Possessor
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Poltergeist inhabit a nonmagical object that is entirely within Close range, infusing the object with a ghostly glow. The next time the Poltergeist would take damage, the object is destroyed instead, and the Poltergeist is expelled from it.

features.name: Ghost Storm
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Poltergeist pull all unequipped nonmagical objects within Very Close range into a violent vortex. Each target in that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **1d12+2** physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

name: Rabble Mawb
description: These cat-sized balls of hair, limbs, and teeth travel in a "mawb" of a dozen.

features.name: Horde
features.text: When the Rabble Mawb has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals **1d4+1** physical damage instead.

features.name: Come Back Worse
features.text: When the Rabble Mawb is defeated, you can **spend a Fear** to bring it back to life, clearing all HP and Stress. The Rabble Mawb gains a bonus to all rolls equal to the number of times this feature has been used by this Rabble Mawb.

name: Redcap Biters
description: A troop of fist-sized fey creatures who have needle-sharp teeth and conical red caps sealed on their heads with candle wax.

features.name: Horde
features.text: When the Biters have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **1d4+2** physical damage instead.

features.name: Ankle Weights
features.text: A PC must mark a Stress to move out of the Biters' Melee range.

name: Redcap Breaker
description: A large, brutish fey creature who has a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax.

features.name: Backbreaker
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal **3d4+10** physical damage. A target who marks HP from this attack is _Restrained_ until they clear a HP.

features.name: Kneecapper
features.text: When the Breaker makes a successful standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to make the target temporarily _Vulnerable._

name: Redcap Butcher
description: A halfling-sized fey creature who hacks their victims apart with a variety of cutting implements. They wear a conical red hat sealed on their head with candle wax.

features.name: Chop Happy
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against up to three targets. For each target who marks HP, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Knife Thrower
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against a target within Far range. If the Butcher is _Hidden,_ they make the attack with advantage.

name: Redcap Candlemaker
description: A pale, gaunt cult leader wearing a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax. They wield a long rod with a candle atop it made from a hanged criminal's hand.

features.name: Hand of Glory
features.text: When the Candlemaker appears, place 5 tokens on this stat block. Remove a token whenever the Candlemaker marks a HP. While this stat block has 1 or more tokens on it, the Candlemaker is _Hidden._

features.name: Torchbearer
features.text: The light of the Candlemaker's Hand of Glory inspires bloodlust in their allies. While this stat block has 1 or more tokens on it, each Redcap adversary within Close range gains a +1 bonus to their damage rolls.

features.name: Dance in the Flames
features.text: **Spend a token** from this stat block. The Candlemaker conjures a ball of fire on a group of PCs within Far range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **2d10** magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

name: Redcap Skinner
description: A cat-sized fey creature wielding a straight razor and wearing a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax.

features.name: Minion
features.text: The Skinner is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Skinner, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Shallow Cuts
features.text: When a PC fails a roll, they take 1 physical damage for each Skinner within Melee range of them. Combine this damage.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Redcap Skinners within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Rugaru
description: A wolf-headed humanoid cursed by the gods to prowl the swamps in search of blood.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Rugaru can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Child of Night
features.text: While in moonlight, the Rugaru gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Bloodthirsty
features.text: When a PC marks HP from the Rugaru's standard attack, add a token to this stat block. The Rugaru gains a bonus to attack rolls equal to the number of tokens on this stat block. Clear all tokens when the Rugaru takes Severe damage.

features.name: Howl at the Moon
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to force each PC within Far range to make a Presence Reaction Roll (15). Targets who fail lose a Hope. Gain a Fear for each Hope lost. If a PC has no Hope, they must mark a Stress and become _Vulnerable_ until they roll with Hope.

features.name: Flesh Ripper
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal **1d12+2** direct physical damage.

name: Sawtoothed Gillbeast
description: A stocky fish creature that has rows of razor-sharp teeth.

features.name: Ka-Chomp
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes **1d12** physical damage and must mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefit (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

features.name: Feeding Frenzy
features.text: When a creature marks HP, you can **spend a Fear** to spotlight all Sawtoothed Gillbeasts within Very Close range of them. Those Gillbeasts move into Melee range of the creature and each make a standard attack against them. If any attacks succeed, combine their damage.

features.name: Scaly
features.text: When the Gillbeast would mark any number of HP, roll a **d6**. On a result of 6, you can mark a Stress instead.

name: Soul-Shattered Mage
description: A spellcaster with a psyche broken by knowledge best left hidden.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Mage can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Broken Magic
features.text:
**Mark a Stress** to roll a **d6**. The Mage uses the corresponding move:
1-2: _Dimension Rift._ Choose a target within Far range. The target teleports to a point you choose within Close range of their original position and takes **2d6** direct magic damage as their body and mind reassemble.
3-4: _Time Dilation._ Choose a group of PCs within Far range. Each target is _Slowed_ until they roll with Hope. While _Slowed_, a target is _Vulnerable_ and must mark a Stress when they move.
5-6: _Discordant Visions._ Make an attack against up to three targets within Close range. Targets the Mage succeeds against take **2d8** direct magic damage.

features.name: Feel My Pain
features.text: When the Mage marks HP, roll a number of **d6s** equal to the number of Stress the Mage has marked. The Mage deals direct magic damage equal to the total result to all PCs within Very Close range.

name: Spellbound Armor
description: An empty suit of full plate armor that glows with a faint corona of ghostly light.

features.name: Tireless
features.text: The Armor can't be forced to mark Stress. When an effect would cause it to mark Stress, the Armor ignores that part of the effect.

features.name: Clatter & Recombobulate
features.text: Once per scene when the Armor is defeated, you can **spend a Fear** to reactivate it. Clear 2 HP and immediately spotlight it.

name: Viper
description: A small serpent that envenomates its prey with hinged fangs.

features.name: Minion
features.text: The Viper is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Viper, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Venomous
features.text: When the Viper makes a successful standard attack, the target becomes temporarily _Envenomated_. While _Envenomated_, the target must mark a Stress whenever they make an action roll.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Vipers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Waxwork Creation
motives: moan with the pain of unlife
description: A ten-foot-tall, semisolid (and semisentient) candle wax construct.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Creation can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: No Vital Organs
features.text: The Creation doesn't take extra damage from attacks that critically succeed against it.

features.name: Wax Ball
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Creation throw a ball of wax at a target within Far range. Make an attack against the target. On a success, the target takes **1d12+2** physical damage and becomes _Restrained_ until they succeed on a Strength Roll (15).

features.name: Splutch!
features.text: When a PC within Melee range of the Creation makes a weapon attack against it, roll a **d6**. On a 5 or higher, the attacker's weapon gets stuck in the Creation and can be removed only with a successful Strength Roll (15).

features.name: Smothering Grapple
features.text: When the Creation makes a successful standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can **spend a Fear** to _Trap_ the target inside the Creation's wax body. While _Trapped_, the target is _Restrained_ and must mark a Stress and move with the Creation each time it's spotlighted. A _Trapped_ creature is freed when the Creation takes Major or greater damage.

name: Will-O’-The-Wisps
description: Lazily floating orbs of color-shifting werelight.

features.name: Horde
features.text: When the Will-o'-the-Wisps have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **1d4-1** magic damage instead.

features.name: Kaleidoscopic
features.text: The Will-o'-the-Wisps pulse and dance in hypnotic, color-changing patterns that entrance any creature who looks upon them. All targets within Very Close range of the Will-o'-the-Wisps are _Vulnerable._

features.name: Fascinating
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Will-o'-the-Wisps trace looping light trails through the air, leaving afterimages that beg to be deciphered. Each PC within Far range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (13) or mark a Stress and move up to Close range toward the Will-o'-the-Wisps.

name: Yufo
description: A large, interdimensional jellyfishlike creature that floats in and out of the timestream.

features.name: Telepathic
features.text: The Yufo can mentally communicate with creatures within Very Far range.

features.name: Psychic Strongbox
features.text: The Yufo is immune to abilities and features that would affect or alter its thoughts or emotions.

features.name: Glitch Wave
features.text: **Spend a Fear** and choose up to three targets within Close range. Each target must succeed on a Instinct Reaction Roll or become desynced from reality and have disadvantage on Instinct Rolls until they use a downtime move to ground their psyches in the now.

features.name: Temporal Corrosion
features.text: When the Yufo succeeds on a standard attack, you can **mark a Stress** to have the Yufo excrete an entropic acid through its skin, giving the target a -2 penalty to their damage thresholds until they use a downtime move to repair their armor.

name: Banshee
description: A corrupted fey spirit that haunts the night in the form of a willowy specter wearing a luminous gossamer gown.

features.name: Specter
features.text: The Banshee has resistance to physical damage. **Mark a Stress** to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Banshee makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Scare Tactic
features.text: Up to three times per scene, **spend a Fear** to have the Banshee teleport up to Very Far range and scare a PC within Melee range. The PC marks **1d4** Stress. If this causes them to mark HP, they also lose a Hope.

features.name: Wail of Despair
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Banshee unleash a mournful scream of pain and anguish. Each PC within Close range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take **1d12+1** magic damage. Targets who fail take double damage and are knocked back to Close range.

name: Basilisk
description: A six-legged monitor lizard that has the head of a vulture, a spiked backbone, and a petrifying gaze.

features.name: Petrify
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to force a PC within Far range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a success, the target marks a Stress. On a failure, the target becomes _Stiff_. If the target is already _Stiff_, they become _Petrified._ While _Stiff_, the PC must mark a Stress each time they act until they take a rest or the Basilisk is defeated. While _Petrified_, the PC can't act. The _Petrified_ condition can be cleared only by applying Basilisk saliva to the target.

features.name: CRONCH!
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Basilisk chomp down on a _Petrified_ PC within Melee range. The target must make a death move.

name: Berserker Alpha
description: A veteran commander who quaffs magic elixirs to change into a beast and lead their packmates on a hunt.

features.name: Pack Fury
features.text: The Alpha gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack's target.

features.name: Bark at the Moon
features.text: Once per scene, **spend a Fear** to have each ally within Close range of the Alpha clear a HP and a Stress.

features.name: Berserker Rage
features.text: The first time in a scene the Alpha marks their last Stress, they gain a +6 bonus to damage rolls.

name: Berserker Initiate
description: A raging warrior who imbibes ritualistic concoctions to enhance their form with aspects of a predatory beast.

features.name: Pack Fury
features.text: The Initiate gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack's target.

features.name: Berserker Rage
features.text: The first time in a scene the Initiate marks their last Stress, they gain a +4 bonus to damage rolls.

name: Centaur Warden
motives: use mobility and distance to drive off intruders
description: A half-human, half-horse guardian who patrols the borders of idyllic lands uncorrupted by the touch of civilization.

features.name: Flanking Maneuver
features.text: When the Warden makes a standard attack against a target within Melee range of one or more of the Warden's allies, the Warden gains a +2 bonus to the attack roll.

features.name: Eye of the Sage
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack. The Warden has advantage on the attack roll and critically succeeds on a roll of 19-20.

features.name: Trample
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Warden gallop up to Far range in a straight line. Each target in their path must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take **1d6+2** physical damage. Targets who fail take double damage and must mark a Stress.

features.name: Quick Volley
features.text: When the Warden makes a standard attack, you can **mark any number of Stress** to target an equal number of additional creatures within range.

name: Chicken-Foot Hut
description: A tall wooden shack that moves around on giant chicken legs.

features.name: Fast
features.text: The Hut can move up to Far range when spotlighted.

features.name: Double Strike
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Pin
features.text: When the Hut makes a successful standard attack, you can **mark a Stress** to temporarily _Restrain_ the target. The Hut drags the _Restrained_ target when it moves.

name: Dire Pangolati
description: A carriage-sized pangolin-coati hybrid covered in armor plating. It has a bladed tail it uses to fling razor-sharp scales.

features.name: Armor Eater
features.text: When the Pangolati makes a successful attack against a PC, that PC must mark an additional Armor Slot to reduce the severity of the damage.

features.name: Blade Spin
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Pangolati quickly spin in a circle. Each target within Very Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **2d8** physical damage.

features.name: Blade Fling
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Pangolati flick its tail and fling a razor-edged armor plate. Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, the attack deals **2d6+10** physical damage.

features.name: Keratin Scales
features.text: When the Pangolati would mark HP from an attack, you can **mark a Stress** to reduce the number of HP it marks by 1.

name: Doppelhound
description: A vicious magical canid that has glowing eyes and two barbed, whiplike tails. It confuses enemies by conjuring an illusory duplicate of itself.

features.name: Blink Beast
features.text: When combat begins, place a duplicate within Close range of the Doppelhound. The Doppelhound occupies both its place and its duplicate's. The duplicate can move when the Doppelhound is spotlighted, and the Doppelhound can target enemies with attacks as if it were in its duplicate's place. When the Doppelhound or duplicate is attacked, the attacker rolls a d6. On an even result, they target the Doppelhound. On an odd result, they target the duplicate, and the attack fails. If an attack succeeds against the Doppelhound, the duplicate is dispelled until you **spend a Fear** to conjure it again.

features.name: Double Strike
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

name: Dragon Knight
description: A knight clad in dragonplate armor and a helmet in the shape of a dragon's head.

features.name: High Ground
features.text: The Knight gains advantage on attacks made against targets below them.

features.name: Leaping Strike
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Knight leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make a standard attack against them. On a success, the attack deals an extra **1d12** damage, and the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

features.name: Comeback
features.text: When the Knight fails a standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to reroll the attack with advantage.

name: Elephant
description: A huge pachyderm that has large ears and a prehensile trunk.

features.name: Trample
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Elephant charge up to Far range in a straight line. Each target in its path must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **2d10+3** physical damage.

features.name: Toss
features.text: When the Elephant makes a successful standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to have it toss the target to another location within Close range and deal an extra **1d12** damage.

name: Entombed Cat Beast
description: A large undead humanoid skeleton with a panther's skull for a head.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Cat Beast can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Bloody Strike
features.text: A PC who marks 3 or more HP from an attack made by the Cat Beast must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Screeching Caterwaul
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to force each PC within Far range of the Cat Beast to make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail become _Rattled_ until they roll with Hope. When the Cat Beast makes a successful attack against a _Rattled_ PC, roll damage twice and take the better result, then clear the _Rattled_ condition from the target.

features.name: I Alone
features.text: When the Cat Beast first appears, you can choose to have them absorb the essence of their allies. Immediately defeat any number of allies on the battlefield, and gain a Fear for each ally defeated this way.

features.name: Vicious Reprisal
features.text: When the Cat Beast takes damage from an attack made by a PC within Very Close range, you can **mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against that PC.

name: Entombed Elite Guard
description: An elite undead soldier buried with their empress to defend the tomb from theft and desecration.

features.name: Battle Formation
features.text: The Guard gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty for each ally within Very Close range.

features.name: Javelin
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Very Far range. On a success, deal **2d6+2** physical damage.

name: Entombed Empress
description: The undead ruler of a forgotten realm. She's been given blasphemous funeral rites to prevent her soul from moving on.

features.name: Empty Husk
features.text: The Empress has resistance to physical damage.

features.name: Missing Organs
features.text: The Empress's internal organs have been removed and placed into six crystal containers hidden throughout her tomb. Each time the PCs find and destroy one, the Empress marks a HP.

features.name: Grasping Chains
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Empress target a creature within Close range and try to telekinetically bind them with her funeral chains. Make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, the Empress pulls the target into Melee range, deals **2d8** physical damage, and temporarily _Restrains_ them.

features.name: Deathless Obedience
features.text: Up to three times per scene, you can **spend a Fear** to spotlight any number of allies within Close range. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Accursed Caress
features.text: When the Empress makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can **spend a Fear** to activate a Doom Countdown (1d6+1) for that PC. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, the PC marks all HP and makes a death move. If the Empress is defeated or the PCs take a rest, all Doom Countdowns end.

features.name: Final Transformation
features.text: When the Empress marks her last HP, replace her with the Entombed Cat Beast and immediately spotlight them.

name: Entombed Necropriest
description: A necromancer charged with preserving the empress's life beyond death.

features.name: Invigorate
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to choose up to three allies within Far range. Each one gains advantage on their next attack roll.

features.name: Last Grasp
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a PC within Far range. Skeletal hands burst out of the ground at the PC's feet and _Restrain_ them until the PC breaks free with a successful Strength Roll. When a target _Restrained_ in this way spends Hope, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Chill Touch
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes standard damage and must mark **1d4** Stress. If the target marks their last Stress from this attack, you gain a Fear.

name: Entombed Skin Beetles
description: Flesh-eating beetles that burrow beneath the skin.

features.name: Horde
features.text: When the Beetles have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **2d4+1** physical damage instead.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Beetles make a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Omophagous
features.text: **Mark a HP** to have 5 Beetles burrow under the skin of a PC within Melee range, forcing them to mark a Stress and _Infecting_ them. While _Infected_, the target takes 6 direct physical damage every time they roll with Fear. This condition is cleared when the PC clears a HP or a Stress.

name: Entombed Stonemason
description: An unfortunate undead laborer chosen by lottery to wall up their empress's tomb from the inside.

features.name: Minion
features.text: The Stonemason is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Stonemason, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range their attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Entombed Stonemasons within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: The Work Never Ends
features.text: When the Stonemason is defeated by an attack that deals physical damage, you can **spend a Fear** to clear the Stonemason's HP and Stress.

name: Flock of Feather Fiends
description: A flock of undead crow corpses, eyes aglow with necroplasmic light.

features.name: Horde
features.text: When the Flock has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals **1d6+1** magic damage instead.

features.name: Maddening Cacophony
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to force each PC within Very Close range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must spend a Hope or become _Vulnerable_ until they deal damage to the Flock or the Flock is defeated.

name: Fowlbear
description: A grizzly bear with a feathery hide and the head of a giant goose.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Fowlbear can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Double Strike
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Dread Honk
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Fowlbear unleash a terrifying, ear-splitting goose honk. Each PC within Close range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark a Stress, move away from the Fowlbear to Far range, and become _Vulnerable_ until the Fowlbear deals damage to them. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or move away from the Fowlbear to Far range.

name: Fungispunj Sporeling
description: A halfling-sized mushroom creature that defends itself from attackers with tiny puffs of neurotoxic spores.

features.name: Minion
features.text: The Sporeling is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Sporeling, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Fungispunj Sporelings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Form Up
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to combine three Sporelings within a Close area and replace them with a Fungispunj Sporophore.

name: Fungispunj Sporophore
description: A giant mushroom creature that can command the dead.

features.name: Neurotoxic Spore Cloud
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Sporophore spray a cloud of spores on all targets within Close range. Each PC must succeed on a Agility Reaction Roll or become _Poisoned_ until they spend a Hope to clear the condition. While _Poisoned_, a target must roll a **d6** before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Reanimator
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Sporophore spray a corpse within Very Close range with a cloud of psychic spores. The corpse clears all HP and Stress, then reanimates under the psychic control of the Sporophore. When the Sporophore is spotlighted, you can also spotlight all corpses it controls.

features.name: Colony
features.text: **Mark any number of Stress** to have the Sporophore summon an equal number of Fungispunj Sporelings within Close range.

features.name: Mind Meld
features.text: All Fungispunj can telepathically communicate with one another. When the Sporophore would be forced to mark Stress from an attack, it can cause Fungispunj allies in the scene to mark that Stress in its place, distributed among allies as it chooses.

name: Gargoyle
description: A magically animated statue resembling a terrifying beast or demon.

features.name: Unliving
features.text: The Gargoyle has resistance to magic damage.

features.name: Swooping Strike
features.text: Choose a point within Far range. The Gargoyle moves to that point and makes a standard attack against one target along its path.

features.name: Petrifying Slash
features.text: When the Gargoyle deals damage, the target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become _Vulnerable_. If the target is already _Vulnerable,_ they become _Restrained_. If the target is already _Vulnerable_ and _Restrained,_ they must make a death move. The PC can spend a Hope per condition to clear it.

name: Giant Octopus
description: A monstrous, aquatic mollusk that has eight sucker-bearing arms and a hard, beaklike jaw.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Octopus can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Armed and Dangerous
features.text: When the Octopus first appears, place a **d8** on this stat block with the 8 value facing up. When the Octopus makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can add the die's value to the damage dealt. After you add its value to a roll, decrease the die's value by 1.

features.name: Grapple
features.text: When the Octopus succeeds on a standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to have the Octopus _Grapple_ the target. While _Grappled_, the target is _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ until they break free with a successful Strength or Finesse Roll.

features.name: Crush
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to deal **3d8** direct physical damage to a target _Grappled_ by the Octopus.

name: Gobstalker
description: A fleshy, floating ball of teeth that has numerous eyes and a bundle of questing mouth tentacles that shoot magic beams.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Gobstalker can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Anti-Mystica-Halitosis
features.text: The Gobstalker's rancid breath creates an invisible, magic-negating miasma. An attack, an ability, or a spell that deals magic damage or creates a magic effect fails automatically if used within Close range of the Gobstalker.

features.name: Tentacle Rays
features.text:
**Mark a Stress** to attack a target within Far range. On a success, roll a **d8** for a random beam attack or **spend a Fear** to choose instead:
1. _Beguile._ The Gobstalker _Beguiles_ the target. While _Beguiled_, the target sees the Gobstalker as a friend and can't attack it. Additionally, when a PC rolls with Fear, a _Beguiled_ PC must mark a Stress or attack a target chosen by the Gobstalker. A _Beguiled_ PC must succeed on an Instinct Roll (16) to clear the condition.
2. _Corrode._ The target takes **2d8** magic damage and must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't, double the damage.
3. _Doom._ The target must mark all HP, but they can spend any number of Hope to reduce the number of HP marked this way by an equal amount.
4. _Hypnosis._ The target falls into a _Deep Trance_ and can't act except to try to wake up. This condition lasts until the target takes damage or wakes up with a successful Presence Roll (16).
5. _Paralyze._ The target freezes in place, becoming _Vulnerable_ and _Restrained_ until they mark 2 Stress.
6. _Sear._ The target takes **2d8** direct magic damage.
7. _Scare._ The target is _Scared_. While _Scared_, the target can't take actions other than fleeing the battle or trying to shake off their terror. Additionally, the target must mark a Stress whenever you spend a Fear. The target can clear the condition with a successful Presence Roll (16).
8. _Slow._ The target becomes _Vulnerable_ and must mark a Stress to move until they spend 2 Hope.

features.name: Leech Lick
features.text: On a successful standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to clear a number of Stress equal to the number of HP the target marked.

name: Guahalan Alebrujo
description: A huge, colorful, chimeric beast formed from many animals.

features.name: The Beast Unleashed
features.text: The Alebrujo gains a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Fear you have.

features.name: Guahalan Sacrifice
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Alebrujo devour a Minion within Very Close range, then clear a HP or a Stress.

features.name: Howl of the Guahala
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Alebrujo emit a howl. Each PC within Far range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or become temporarily _Panicked_. While _Panicked_, a PC must mark a Stress when they take the spotlight.

features.name: Rip & Tear
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to make a standard attack with advantage. On a success, you can **mark a Stress** to make another standard attack against an additional target within range. You can continue marking Stress to make additional attacks until the Alebrujo fails an attack roll.

features.name: Brutal Spectacle
features.text: When the Alebrujo deals Severe damage, you can **spend a Fear** to force all targets within Close range to mark a Stress.

name: Guahalan Fang Lord
description: A shapeshifting warlord who leads a group of warriors into battle.

features.name: Pack Alpha
features.text: _Pool_. When the Fang Lord makes a successful attack, add a token to the Guahalan Pool. When a Guahalan ally within Close range makes an attack, you can **spend a token** from the Guahalan Pool to give them advantage on the roll.

features.name: Unleash the Beast
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Fang Lord adopt a bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Call of the Guahala
features.text: **Spend 2 Fear** to spotlight all Guahalan Shifters within Close range. Each one makes a standard attack against a target within range. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine their damage.

features.name: Feral Form
features.text: When the Fang Lord marks their last HP, replace them with the Guahalan Alebrujo and immediately spotlight them.

name: Guahalan Shifter
description: A shapeshifting masked warrior who has animalistic features.

features.name: Unleash the Beast
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Shifter adopt a more bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Pack Attack
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack. On a success, the attack gains a bonus to damage equal to the number of other Shifters within Very Close range of the target.

name: Guahalan Spirit Beast
description: A brightly colored spirit in the shape of an animal.

features.name: Minion
features.text: The Spirit Beast is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Spirit Beast, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Ethereal Form
features.text: The Spirit Beast has resistance to physical damage.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Beast Bomb
features.text: When the Spirit Beast is defeated, it explodes in white flame and deals 5 magic damage to creatures within Melee range.

name: Guahalan Spirit Singer
description: A shapeshifting summoner who has animalistic features.

features.name: Unleash the Beast
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Spirit Singer adopt a more bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Beast-Caller
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Spirit Singer summon **2d4** Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Very Close range and immediately spotlight one.

features.name: Rage of Spirits
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to spotlight any number of Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Very Close range and have each one move into Melee range with the nearest PC and make a standard attack. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine their damage.

features.name: Spiritual Sacrifice
features.text: When the Spirit Singer would take damage while within Very Close range of a Guahalan Spirit Beast, you can **spend a Fear** to sacrifice the Spirit Beast and negate the damage.

name: Hill Titan
description: A goliath clad in animal skins and surrounded by a swarm of insects.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Gullible
features.text: PCs have advantage on action rolls to trick or emotionally manipulate the Titan.

features.name: Bug Swarm
features.text: PCs are _Vulnerable_ while within Very Close range.

features.name: Mighty Swing
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range.

name: Hive Walker
description: A corpse filled with and puppeted by a colony of carrion-eating bees.

features.name: Blood Honey
features.text: The Walker disgorges thick crimson honey at all targets between it and a point within Close range. Each target in that line must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **2d8** magic damage and become temporarily _Restrained_ as the honey hardens on them.

features.name: Bee-Ruption
features.text: When the Walker marks HP, vengeful bees erupt from its body to protect it. Each target within Very Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take **1d8** direct physical damage for each HP the Hive Walker has marked. _Restrained_ targets automatically fail the reaction roll.

name: Jack-O’-Lantern
description: A floating pumpkin or other gourd that has a face carved into it. The soul trapped within it emits an eerie glow.

features.name: Minion
features.text: The Jack-o'-Lantern is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Jack-o'- Lantern, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Jack-o'-Lanterns within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 6 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Spine-Chilling Cackle
features.text: When a PC within Very Close range rolls with Fear, you can **mark a Stress** to gain an additional Fear.

name: Landshark
description: A quadrupedal shark that swims through the ground.

features.name: Burrowing
features.text: The Landshark can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the Landshark moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the Landshark has resistance to all damage but can't attack.

features.name: Thick-Skinned
features.text: When the Landshark would be forced to mark any number of HP, you can mark an equal number of Stress instead.

features.name: Rending Chomp
features.text: When the Landshark makes a successful attack against a PC within Melee range, you can **spend a Fear** to force the target to mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

name: Landshark Behemoth
description: A landshark that's lived long enough to become a large burrowing monstrosity with steely hide and razor-sharp teeth.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Behemoth can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Deep Diver
features.text: The Behemoth can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the Behemoth moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the Behemoth is immune to damage but can't attack.

features.name: Steel-Skinned
features.text: All damage dealt to the Behemoth is reduced by one threshold.

features.name: Forceful Eruption
features.text: The Behemoth erupts from the ground, forcing each PC within Very Close range to succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or be knocked over, becoming _Vulnerable_ until they make an action roll. For each PC made _Vulnerable_ in this way, you gain a Fear.

name: Ravenous Mockery
description: A shapeshifting predator that assumes the appearance of inanimate objects to lure unwary prey into its threat range.

features.name: Tongue Attack
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to attack a creature within Close range. On a success, the target is pulled into Melee range with the Mockery and _Restrained_ until they escape with a successful Strength Roll, and you can **spend a Fear** to activate the Mockery's Devour feature against the target.

features.name: Devour
features.text: Attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the Mockery _Swallows_ the target. While _Swallowed_, the target is _Restrained_ and marks a HP when the Mockery is spotlighted. The Mockery disgorges all _Swallowed_ creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.

features.name: Never Just One
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to reveal that another object on the battlefield has been a Ravenous Mockery the whole time, then immediately spotlight it.

name: Rust Eater
description: A pony-sized cockroach coated in a corrosive chitin that turns metal into rust.
